result.justification: The research objective is present, stating the evaluation of NONS against various viruses, but the methodology lacks some details needed for full clarity.

evidence.quote: This comprehensive assessment is important because most of these viruses replicate initially in the upper respiratory tract before disseminating to the lungs.
The virucidal efficacy of the nitric oxide nasal formulation (NONS) was evaluated against a panel of respiratory viruses representing both enveloped and non-enveloped RNA viruses.
